records.finding: The decoder comment assumes punctured columns, but it does not prove that the API rejects mother-code LLRs. The copy loop starts at column zero and copies the caller-supplied prefix. OAI mother-code compatibility is unvalidated, not proven impossible.
The decoder selects parity-check processing when check_crc is null; with a CRC callback it checks CRC instead. It is not necessarily syndrome plus CRC.
The decoder performs a first iteration before initializing numIter to zero. Its nominal cap/counter cannot be assumed identical to the matched gf2/AFF3CT contract.

The decoder calls the two-pass check-node path. Its AVX2 group function selects the two smallest absolute magnitudes, clips to maxLLR, and restores the sign. It does not apply an OMS offset; the earlier OMS label is unsupported. Compile-time dispatch selects 512-, 256-, or 128-bit group functions; no successful local OAI binary build is claimed.
